title: Repository visibility and execution policy research
summary: Preserve current public free standard hosted runner policy. Explore private standard hosted allowance or owner-approved spend, private self-hosted runners and direct local execution as distinct provenance. No private execution approval or release gate is implied.
benefits: Same branch and workflow across authorized environments.
risks: Private evidence exposure, mutable local runner state, unexpected billing, visibility changes and false public-runner equivalence.

evidence.claim: Current public-runner profile excludes private execution.
